skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Presents
skins.content: Schwarz's Personal Winter Collection/Presents. Some elements of this outfit run antithetical to the holiday spirit, but she hasn't seemed to notice. More important things are on her mind.
skins.quote: 'What kind of present... would she like?'

skins.name: Skyline
skins.content: Striker Series/Skyline. A product of Raythean Industries, geared for hypothetical city combat environs. Along with basic protection, the application of the latest in reflective paint allows specialist personnel to blend into the complex surroundings of the city.
skins.usage: One part of Schwarz's tactical equipment.
skins.quote: Schwarz knows there's a little blue being who'll follow her. Schwarz has always known.
